observations: All four photos show a rectangular photovoltaic module with half-cut monocrystalline cells arranged in two columns of cell-strings.
Photo 0 and 1 show the front (cell) side with strong glare across the surface, obscuring parts of the cells.
Photo 2 and 3 show the white back sheet with a junction box in the center and two MC4-style connector cables, one on each side.
A small printed label is visible on the back sheet near the junction box in photo 3, but the text is too small/blurred to read any brand or wattage.
A 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' watermark appears across photos 0-3, indicating the seller's own marketing overlay, not a product label.
Background shows a cluttered shop/warehouse setting with other panels, cables, and sacks; a man is visible bending over a sack in photos 0 and 1.
No battery, charge controller, inverter, or any battery-related equipment appears in any of the four photos.
No visible cracks, chips, or discoloration on the glass/cells can be confirmed due to glare; frame edges appear straight and undamaged where visible.

identity.kind: solar panel (photovoltaic module, half-cut cell type)

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No battery appears in any of the 4 photos (0-3); all four show only a solar panel, front and back. The claim does not match the pictured item.

claims.claim: Implied: this is a new/undamaged solar panel.
claims.evidence: Glare in photos 0 and 1 obscures much of the cell surface, so cracks or micro-damage cannot be ruled out from the images.

risks.risk: Seller's text describes a battery, but photos show only a panel; the actual item for sale is unclear or the listing may be mismatched/copy-pasted.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the actual battery being sold, or confirmation from seller that the battery text is a template error and the panel is the only item.
risks.if_unproven: priced as solar panel only, with no battery included

risks.risk: Wattage, voltage, and brand of the panel cannot be read from the label photo.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rear specification label showing brand, model, and wattage.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end of generic unbranded half-cut panels of estimated size

risks.risk: Glare obscures the cell surface, so hairline cracks or hotspots are unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Photos taken at an angle without direct light reflection, or an electroluminescence/flash test if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly having undetected cell damage

risks.risk: No way to confirm actual power output or whether the panel is functional under load.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the panel connected to a multimeter/charge controller showing voltage/current output under sunlight.

risks.risk: Physical size/dimensions not confirmed, which affects wattage class and price tier.
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure against the panel's length and width.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest plausible wattage class for this cell layout

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the rear specification label (brand, model, wattage, voltage).
Clarify whether a battery is actually included in this sale, and if so, photos of that battery.
Photo of the panel from a non-glare angle showing full cell surface.
Video/photo of panel output reading on a multimeter under sunlight.
Photo with a measuring tape showing panel dimensions.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a solar panel of a generic half-cut-cell type that can be priced at a worst-case (unverified wattage, unverified working output, unbranded) level; the seller's battery claim is contradicted by the images and should be disregarded or clarified separately.
